figurative_meaning_en: To get under one's control, to obtain cunningly or by trickery
example_sentences_in_bangla: এবার তোমাকে বাগে পেয়েছি, আর পালাতে পারবে না।
সে তার শত্রুকে বাগে পেয়ে খুব খুশি হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: This time I've got you in my trap, you can't escape now.
He was thrilled after getting his rival under his control.
note: The idiom draws from the imagery of trapping or enclosing, common in Bengali folklore and oral traditions.
